tasks.label: Inspect optional-chaining inner func debug
tasks.command: pnpm -s exec tsx -e 'import { parseBytecodeModule } from "./src/bytecodeReader"; import fs from "fs"; function inner(mod:any){ const cp=mod.func.cpool||[]; const f=cp.find((e:any)=>e && typeof e==="object" && e.tag===12); return f; } const ts=parseBytecodeModule(fs.readFileSync("artifacts/optional-chaining.ts.qbc")); const wasm=parseBytecodeModule(fs.readFileSync("artifacts/optional-chaining.wasm.qbc")); const tsIn=inner(ts); const wasmIn=inner(wasm); console.log("TS inner?",!!tsIn,"WASM inner?",!!wasmIn); if(tsIn&&wasmIn){ console.log("TS inner bytecodeLen",tsIn.bytecodeLen,"WASM",wasmIn.bytecodeLen); console.log("TS inner hasDebug",tsIn.hasDebug,"WASM",wasmIn.hasDebug); console.log("TS inner pc2lineLen",tsIn.debug?.pc2line?.length||0,"WASM",wasmIn.debug?.pc2line?.length||0); console.log("TS inner filename",tsIn.debug?.filename, "WASM", wasmIn.debug?.filename); }'

tasks.label: Decode optional-chaining pc2line (outer+inner)
debug: scan OP_line_num in class-methods
tasks.command: pnpm -s exec tsx -e "import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'; import {parseBytecodeModule} from './src/bytecodeReader'; const OP=200; function scan(label,qbc){ const m=parseBytecodeModule(readFileSync(qbc)); const bc=m.func.cpool[1].bytecode; const hits=[]; for(let i=0;i<=bc.length-5;i++){ if(bc[i]===OP){ const v=(bc[i+1]|(bc[i+2]<<8)|(bc[i+3]<<16)|(bc[i+4]<<24))>>>0; hits.push({i,sourcePos:v}); } } console.log(label, hits); } scan('TS','artifacts/class-methods/bytecode/class-methods.ts.qbc'); scan('WASM','artifacts/class-methods/bytecode/class-methods.wasm.qbc');"
